Definition: the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front)
BiblicalUsage: The Philistines pitch in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven, and Gog's burial valley lies on the east of the sea. The word is the forward part, the east, the front of things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe east is the direction of the sunrise and the front of the camp, and God puts his people facing it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
